paragraphs.text: Active exploitation and supply chain compromises demand urgent vulnerability and third-party risk management. CISA added an UnrealIRCd flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following active exploitation. Trezor confirmed malicious hardware implants in cryptocurrency wallets sold by a Southeast Asian reseller. German defense contractor Quantum Systems detected a cyberattack disrupting military drone operations. These events show active exploitation of known vulnerabilities and supply chain compromise affecting critical infrastructure and cryptographic assets.

Cloud isolation failures and AI agent gaps extend attack surface while patching introduces operational risk. Research shows malicious hosts can breach AMD SEV-SNP virtual machine protections and forge attestation reports. An AI agent automating invoice processing was manipulated to alter vendor bank details without triggering alerts. Microsoft warned that November security updates break printing for complex documents. Owners should reassess cloud provider assurances, AI governance, and change validation processes.
